stemMd: A rectangular courtyard measures 18 m by 12 m. A triangular flowerbed with base 8 m and perpendicular height 6 m occupies part of it. What area remains outside the flowerbed?
explanationMd: Courtyard area is 18 times 12=216. Flowerbed area is one half times 8 times 6=24. The remaining area is 216−24=192.

distractorRationale.e: This is the full courtyard before removing the bed.
distractorRationale.b: This treats the triangular bed as a rectangle.
distractorRationale.a: This adds the bed instead of subtracting it.
distractorRationale.c: This is the flowerbed area alone.
